stem_book: Two blocks are connected to an ideal spring of stiffness 200 N/m. At a certain moment, the two blocks are moving in opposite directions (away from each other) with speeds 4 m/s and 6 m/s, and the instantaneous elongation of the spring is 10 cm. The rate at which the spring energy (kx²/2) is increasing is (a) 500 J/s (b) 400 J/s (c) 200 J/s (d) 100 J/s
reason: '(away from each other)' added — the energy is 'increasing' only if they separate.
